scope: ECON-001 first-task replication: sector association with reported AI use, not AI-productivity association or effect. No original discovery and parent remains OPEN.
population: Census BTOS in-scope U.S. employer businesses, including single- and multi-location since September 2023; farm and additional published scope exclusions apply. Nonemployers are not represented. No claim this covers every U.S. firm.

units.underlying: Business survey reporting unit, associated with EIN per Census respondent FAQ; do not assume enterprise/consolidated-firm identity.
units.analysis: Three published aggregate percentage estimates, not three independent businesses. Two sector domains plus an overlapping national benchmark.

time: Reported AI use in past two weeks; source identifies collection period ending May 3, 2026. Do not infer response-specific exact dates.
treatment: No causal treatment assigned. Observed binary self-report of AI use in any business function, distinct from AI exposure, investment, intensity, integration, and generative AI specifically.
outcome: Published percentage reporting current AI use. No productivity, TFP, revenue, employment, quality or time-savings outcomes available.

estimands.primary: Published Information percentage minus published Finance and Insurance percentage, in percentage points. Descriptive domain association only.
secondary: Finance and Insurance minus National, percentage points
estimands.ratios: Same three ordered rate ratios, rounded half-even to 12 decimal places; ratios refer only to displayed percentages.
estimands.multiple_comparisons: All three comparisons frozen; no hypothesis tests, rankings over omitted sectors, model selection or significance claims.

weights: Retain published survey-weighted percentages; no reweighting or averaging sectors. Read 2023 methodology v4 describes sampling weights times state-size and sector-size nonresponse factors; percentage denominator includes businesses responding to the question. Actual 2026 weights and revisions not inspected, so do not claim an independent survey estimate.
missingness: Require exactly these three complete cells. Reject missing, nonnumeric, duplicate, out-of-range, wrong-unit or wrong-date data. Do not impute missing/suppressed cells. Selection/nonresponse bias cannot be corrected with aggregate excerpt.
uncertainty: No standard errors or covariances extracted. National includes sector observations: independence assumption prohibited. No CIs or p-values. Conditional rounding sensitivity only: if each published cell is rounded to nearest 0.1 pp, latent display-compatible point estimates lie within +/-0.05 pp; contrast envelope +/-0.10 pp and ratio min/max from endpoint arithmetic. This envelope is not a sampling interval and the rounding convention is an assumption.
measurement_caveats: Core AI wording broadened on November 17, 2025 from production to any business function. Never splice before/after values as a homogeneous adoption growth series.
Self-reported use is not exogenous adoption nor verified intensity; respondent interpretation, selection and misclassification remain.
National overlap and multi-sector classification prevent computing non-sector controls by subtraction.
Survey end date is not adoption date; one cross-section cannot test pretrends.

acceptance.A1: Source extract SHA256 unchanged and exact three rates, definition, percent unit, and endpoint match source. Outputs deterministic decimal pp differences and 12-place ratios for three prespecified contrasts.
acceptance.A2: Point difference equals source decimal subtraction; Info-National equals (Info-Finance)+(Finance-National); ratio product identity within 2e-12.
acceptance.A3: Conditional rounding envelopes computed from stated endpoints, contain displayed point arithmetic. No interval labelled confidence interval; no standard errors, p-values or causal estimates fabricated.
acceptance.A4: Positive decimal control, equal-rate boundary, missing/duplicate/invalid percent/wrong date/wrong unit rejects, wrong arithmetic and source hash corruption controls must be detected.
acceptance.A5: DAG plus future causal estimand, requirements/assumptions and pretrend/placebo feasibility, measurement sensitivity and alternative outcomes documented; independent review pending until coordinator report.

budget.expected: <20 deterministic calculation/control cases; one CPU process; no packages, paid API, GPU or extra worker.

stop: Stop at 30 minutes after assigned task start (11:53 UTC), after bounded deliverable, upon main-project priority request, source-integrity failure or missing permission.
